reports.title: Jaily Waily: Ian Hislop and Private Eye on Russell Brand's prison sentence
reports.description:
Ian Hislop, Adam Macqueen, Andrew Hunter Murray and Justine Smith discuss the long, long failure in the media to notice Russell Brand telling the world who he was; with extra reports on the calls for help from Samaritans volunteers and the ‘Dirty COP’ climate conference happening in Turkey.

In the UK, the Samaritans can be contacted on 116 123. In the US, the National Suicide Prevention Hotline is 1-800-273-8255. In Australia, the crisis support service Lifeline is on 13 11 14.

reports.description: The latest break in Peter Mandelson’s CV, the other secrets hiding in the Epstein files, and what comes next for the British government... with Ian Hislop, Helen Lewis, Adam MacQueen and Andrew Hunter Murray.
